new_value: {"notes":"Implemented in git-vouch: History/registry_history (linear order = git rev-list --topo-order --reverse HEAD; working tree is one pending version at index final; a non-git dir has only that version, so plain-dir tests keep snapshot semantics). check_registry: tier record judged by approver's claimed+valid tier at the commit that added its current content (History.added), recursion ends because claimed rank strictly falls; tier record committed before its person file -\u003e void (warning); key in two files -\u003e first listing commit owns, later lister is an error and dropped, same-commit ties keep the old current-key rule; every revocation version ever committed counts, processed in commit order, signer eligibility (key itself, subject's and anchors' unretired keys) taken from files at that commit, void if signer revoked in a strictly earlier commit, same-commit revocations all count; CheckResult gains warnings (revoked key still current). Errors only for working-tree versions; historical bad versions are silent. Tests: tests/test_check_history.py (13 tests, real git + ssh-keygen; snapshot-copy cross-checks). Open question: automation accountable still judged at the current tree (accountable stepping down = error)."}
